name: Advanced Sales Reports For WooCommerce
author: Anzar Ahmed

sections.description:
Advanced Sales Reports for woocommerce extends WooCommerce by providing comprehensive sales reports beyond the default WooCommerce reports.
It helps store owners understand customer behavior, product performance, payment trends, coupon usage, and stock status.

Key Features:
* Dashboard with KPIs and top-selling products/customers.
* Order reports with filters.
* Product sales reports.
* Customer sales reports.
* Order status breakdown.
* Payment method analysis.
* Coupon usage tracking.
* Stock reports and low-stock alerts.
* Product category sales performance.
* AJAX-powered filters for faster reporting.

This plugin is lightweight and integrates seamlessly into the WordPress admin panel under Sales Report.

Arbitrary section

Future features planned:
* CSV and Excel export.
* Email scheduling of reports.
* Advanced date filters (quarterly, yearly).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-sales-reports-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Sales Report → Dashboard to view reports.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, WooCommerce must be active for this plugin to work.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, it only loads in the admin panel, and reports are optimized with AJAX.

Can I export the reports?

Currently, export is not included, but CSV export will be added in a future release.
